comment: Project-specific policy layer for cutternest-kit. This layer overrides or extends policies.base.json and policies.stack.json with domain-specific rules for local TOTP, guest PIN, SQLite MVP, optional PostgreSQL/Redis in Fase 2, and optional WhatsApp gateway in Fase 4.

require_approval_for: Change TOTP issuer or encryption key handling
Add or remove MFA methods (TOTP, guest PIN)

escalation_required: any agent holding more than max_concurrent_tokens active tokens
any agent accepting a new task without revoking the previous token
db-agent executing DROP or DELETE without WHERE
backend-agent leaving orphaned service, route, util or test file after a refactor
db-agent adding or modifying a table not consumed by any backend service or route
db-agent keeping legacy scripts with conflicting table definitions
any agent creating duplicate or conflicting schema definitions for the same entity
any agent exposing TOTP encryption key or guest PIN secrets
